in_hebrew.name: בֵּן־נוֹ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בן נו, 'בן' - 'son' 'נו' - 'us' - 'son of us' - 'child of God' - 'name given to Christians in honor of their faith' - ' symbolizing spiritual birth and divine kinship' - 'reflecting the relationship between God and humanity'

in_greek.name: Βεννώ
in_greek.long_meaning: Βεν - 'son' ώ - 'of us' - 'name given to Christians in honor of their faith' - ' symbolizing spiritual birth and divine kinship' - 'reflecting the relationship between God and humanity' - 'originates from Hebrew באן בן'

in_latin.name: Benno
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen filius, 'son' of a person, derived from Hebrew באן בן, reflecting the relationship between God and humanity, symbolizing spiritual birth and divine kinship, name given to Christians in honor of their faith, reflecting the patrilineal tradition in early Christian church
